caption: instrumental film score for a short family documentary, East African feel, warm and gentle, quiet enough to sit under a spoken voice, no lead vocals. Structure: sparse plucked strings, gentle and hopeful, slow, instrumental; then the same theme with soft hand percussion, steady forward motion, instrumental; then the opening theme returns warmer and fuller, then resolves softly, instrumental.
